source_refs.note: Exercise 2.1, Question 15 (i)-(ii): implicit differentiation; book p. 41. Unit 2 has no printed answers.

blocks.prompt: 15 (i) Use implicit differentiation to find \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) if: \(ax^2 + by^2 + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan \(y\) akela ek taraf nahi likha, balke \(x\) aur \(y\) ek hi equation mein ghule mile hain. Aise relation ko implicit kehte hain.
Diya kya hai? \(ax^2 + by^2 + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\). Find kya karna hai? \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Rule kaunsa? Implicit differentiation (section 2.3.3): har term ko \(x\) ke respect se differentiate karo aur \(y\) ko \(x\) ka function samjho.
Plan: differentiate, \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) wali terms ek taraf, baqi doosri taraf, phir divide.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(ax^2 + by^2 + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\), jahan \(a, b, c, f, g\) constants hain.
Maloom karna: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Tareeqa: implicit differentiation. Jis term mein \(y\) ho, us ke derivative ke saath chain rule ki wajah se \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) zaroor lagta hai, kyunke \(y\) khud \(x\) par depend karta hai.

Har term ko \(x\) ke respect se differentiate karein
\[2ax + 2by\dfrac{dy}{dx} + 2g + 2f\dfrac{dy}{dx} + 0 = 0\]
Kyun: \((ax^2)' = 2ax\); \((by^2)' = 2by\frac{dy}{dx}\) (chain rule); \((2gx)' = 2g\); \((2fy)' = 2f\frac{dy}{dx}\); \(c\) constant hai to 0.
Dhyan dein: \(a, b, c, f, g\) sirf numbers hain, variables nahi. \(c\) ka derivative 0 hai, aur \(2gx\) ke saath \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) nahi lagta kyunke us mein \(y\) nahi.

\(\frac{dy}{dx}\) wali terms ikatthi karein
\[(2by + 2f)\dfrac{dy}{dx} = -(2ax + 2g)\]
Kyun: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) wali terms left par rakhin aur common nikala; baqi terms right par le gaye to un ka sign badal gaya.

Solve karein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = -\dfrac{2(ax + g)}{2(by + f)} = -\dfrac{ax + g}{by + f}\]
Kyun: dono taraf \(2(by + f)\) se divide kiya aur 2 cancel. Yeh tab jaiz hai jab \(by + f \neq 0\).

Tasdeeq: circle ki misaal
\[a = b = 1,\ g = f = 0:\ x^2 + y^2 = -c\]
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = -\dfrac{x}{y}\]
Kyun: yeh origin wala circle ban gaya, jis ka slope \(-\frac{x}{y}\) hum pehle se jaante hain. Hamara general formula bhi yahi de raha hai.

blocks.prompt: 15 (ii) Use implicit differentiation to find \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) if: \(x + \tan(xy) = 0\)
blocks.explanation:
Phir implicit relation, lekin is dafa \(y\) ek \(\tan\) ke andar \(x\) ke saath multiply ho kar chhupa hai.
Diya kya hai? \(x + \tan(xy) = 0\). Find kya karna hai? \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Rule kaunsa? Implicit differentiation, aur us ke andar do rules: \(\tan(xy)\) ke liye chain rule aur \(xy\) ke liye product rule.
Plan: differentiate, \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ko alag karna, phir jawab ko saaf karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x + \tan(xy) = 0\).
Maloom karna: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Tareeqa: dono taraf \(x\) ke respect se differentiate karenge; right side 0 ka derivative 0 hai.

\(x\) ke respect se differentiate karein
\[1 + \sec^2(xy)\dfrac{d}{dx}(xy) = 0\]
Kyun: \((x)' = 1\). \(\tan(xy)\) mein bahar \(\tan\) aur andar \(xy\) hai, to chain rule: \(\sec^2(xy)\) darja andar ka derivative.

\(xy\) par product rule
\[1 + \sec^2(xy)\left(y + x\dfrac{dy}{dx}\right) = 0\]
Kyun: \(xy\) do variables ka product hai: \((x)'y + x(y)' = y + x\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{d}{dx}(xy)\) ko sirf \(y\) ya sirf \(x\frac{dy}{dx}\) likhna aam ghalti hai; dono hisse chahiye.

Ikattha kar ke solve karein
\[x\sec^2(xy)\dfrac{dy}{dx} = -1 - y\sec^2(xy)\]
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = -\dfrac{1 + y\sec^2(xy)}{x\sec^2(xy)}\]
Kyun: bracket khola, \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) wali term left par rakhi, baqi \(1\) aur \(y\sec^2(xy)\) right par le gaye (sign badal kar). Phir \(x\sec^2(xy)\) se divide kiya.

Saaf shakal
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = -\dfrac{\cos^2(xy) + y}{x}\]
Kyun: upar neeche \(\sec^2(xy)\) se divide kiya; \(\frac{1}{\sec^2(xy)} = \cos^2(xy)\). Jawab chhota ho gaya.

Tasdeeq: curve ki apni equation se
\[\tan(xy) = -x \Rightarrow \sec^2(xy) = 1 + x^2\]
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = -\dfrac{1 + y(1 + x^2)}{x(1 + x^2)}\]
Kyun: diye gaye relation se \(\tan(xy) = -x\), aur identity \(\sec^2 = 1 + \tan^2\) se \(\sec^2(xy) = 1 + x^2\). Is se trig ke baghair shakal mili; sympy ka implicit derivative bhi isi se milta hai. Teeno shaklein sahi hain.
